description: The number-row tap keys: the key left of 1 and the two right of 0, each assignable to any catalogue action and swallowed when tapped alone. Their defaults live in the features manifest (shortcuts.tap_keys.<id>). `ahk` is the AutoHotkey scancode, `hs` the macOS keycodes the key can arrive as (the key left of 1 is kVK_ANSI_Grave on an ANSI keyboard and behind Karabiner's ANSI virtual keyboard, kVK_ISO_Section on a bare ISO one; the first is the one its label is read from), `linux` the evdev keycode. Pinned to the Windows hotkeys by tools/test/test-tap-keys-single-source.cjs.
